turns.text: I remember I had my phone in my, oh,
turns.zh: 我记得我把手机放在我的，哦，

turns.text: I remember I had my phone, we weren't allowed to take it to school and I never did because there was no point because I could never go on it.
turns.zh: 我记得我把手机……我们那时候不准带手机去学校，我也从来没带过，因为带了也没用，我根本没法玩。

turns.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, there's no point.
But one day I did for some reason and I didn't, I panicked, I was like, what am I gonna do with it?
turns.zh: 但有一天我不知怎么的就带了，然后我……我慌了，我就想，我该拿它怎么办啊？

turns.text: And it was in my pencil case in maths and my…
turns.zh: 然后它就在我数学课的笔袋里，我的……

turns.text: What kind of a phone would fit in a pencil case?
turns.zh: 什么样的手机能塞进笔袋里啊？

turns.text: I don't know, it was one of those ones with like the typey ones.
turns.zh: 不知道，就是那种带按键的那种。
